verdict.rationale: Basecamp's Docs & Files natively holds cloud files from Google Docs (and Dropbox and Figma), which loosely covers the Google Drive part of the story. The evidence shows no native Slack or GitHub integration; Basecamp instead positions its own chat as a replacement for Slack. The REST API and OAuth are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. missing for 10: native Slack integration, native GitHub integration, a documented full Google Drive integration beyond embedding cloud files, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can connect common tools like Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive natively

citations.quote: Docs & Files keeps images, documents, PDFs, even cloud files from Figma, Google Docs, and Dropbox neatly organized inside your projects.
